messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'll be oncall 09:00–17:00 UTC tomorrow. Doing pre-oncall prep now. :wave:

sam: Quick checklist I'm running through: VPN access, PagerDuty login, SSH keys to bastion, runbooks pinned, KMS/credentials, and a test alert. Runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.company/runbooks/oncall-prep (see 'pre-shift checklist')

irene: I can swap if you need. Confirmed VPN + PD access. How do you trigger the test alert?

sam: Two options: run the test script or use the PD slack integration. Script (from repo root):
```
./scripts/pd-test.sh --service inference-prod --env prod
```
Or in slack: `/pagerduty test inference-prod` (will create a fake alert, auto-resolve after 30s).

maria: FYI — there is a DB replica promotion planned tomorrow 02:00 UTC that might spike alerts (connection resets / increased error rate). Keep an eye on the replica-lag and db-connections runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.company/runbooks/db-operations

dave: Added you to the infra IAM group and PagerDuty schedule. If you still can't access KMS, DM me and I'll add the role `redwood-inference-oncall`. Also confirm bastion SSH key: `~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pem`

sam: Triggered the test alert, got push + sms. PagerDuty delivered to my phone. Test log: `pagerduty-bot: test alert delivered to sam at 1764008200`

irene: Great. What's the escalation path if PD fails? Phone numbers?

sam: Escalation notes (pinned to runbook): primary -> infra (dave) via PagerDuty, secondary -> maria (mobile: +1-555-0147). If PD notifications fail entirely call dave mobile (+1-555-0102) then ping #eng-sre in Slack.

maria: Also a quick reminder to validate service tokens before taking ownership: run `scripts/check-tokens.sh` and confirm no expired tokens for inference-prod. If you see `TOKEN_EXPIRED` email sec-ops and rotate via KMS console.

sam: SSH to bastion (example): `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pem ubuntu@bastion.redwood.internal` — then `./runbooks/connect-to-model-servers.sh`. Verified connectivity just now.

dave: Left a short note in the oncall page about the migration risk window 02:00–04:00 UTC. If you see repeated 502s, follow the rollback checklist in the deploy runbook.

sam: All set. Leaving a short handoff summary in the runbook: shift start 09:00 UTC, expected load normal, watch DB migration window at 02:00 UTC, PD + VPN validated, KMS role present. I'll be reachable until 09:30 UTC if someone needs to swap. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: test alert (simulation) received by sam at 1764008200 — auto-resolve scheduled in 30s.

irene: Got everything — thanks for the clear notes. If you want a swap I'll take the 10:00–18:00 slot.

sam: Thanks — I'll ping if anything changes. Leaving the shift page linked and pinned.
